description: Bundle-size budget for scripts/check-bundle-size.js (roadmap W10.1). `targets` are the budgets the gate was written with; the bundle has never met them. `ceilings` are the measured sizes on 2026-10-01 (vendor-map 2598 KB, index 726 KB, total 10758 KB) plus ~2% headroom, so the gate can block in CI today: growth past a ceiling fails, and a ceiling more than 5% above what is measured fails too, until it is lowered. Ceilings only go DOWN — DEFECT-0027 (the schema chunk in the client bundle) is the first planned reduction. W10.1b (2026-10-01) lowered both: removing the MapLibre preview engine (maplibre-gl held the repo's one critical advisory) took vendor-map from 2598 to 1796 KB and the total from 10758 to 9958 KB. A chunk named here is keyed by its Vite name, without the content hash. W2 (2026-10-10) lowered both again: Mapbox GL replaced by MapLibre GL 6 (with maplibre-contour and pmtiles in the same chunk) took vendor-map from 1796 to 1068 KB and the total to 9435 KB; ceilings are those plus ~2%. CORRECTION 2026-10-11 (launch stack -> main): the W2 total of 9435 KB was measured before the W2 audit's fix that emits the MapLibre web worker as its own asset (maplibre-gl-worker, 495 KB; without it every map was blank in production), so the 9625 KB total ceiling was never true of a working build. Measured with the worker on the integrated stack: 10008 KB, against main's 9958 KB on the same day (+50 KB, 0.5%: vendor-map -729 KB, worker +495 KB, W3-W5 pages +~280 KB). The total ceiling returns to main's 10160 KB -- no increase over main, 1.5% above measured, inside the 5% lowering slack. vendor-map stays at 1090 KB. The bundle-size check runs only on PRs into main (ci.yml), so it never ran on the stacked W2-W5 branches; that is how the stale number survived. 2026-10-12 (route-load performance): the mobile quick-add sheet (zod, shared contracts, cmdk) moved out of the entry chunk to load on first tap; index measured 733 -> 616 KB, ceiling that plus ~2% (628 KB). The total rose 10008 -> 10047 KB (the sheet's code now ships as separate lazy chunks instead of inside the entry; nothing was added), still under the 10160 KB ceiling. Re-measured 2026-10-18 after merging main (0d0890fd): index 616 KB (ceiling 628 KB unchanged), total 10074 KB.
